body: Source: GitHub issue #938. Update the trust-root paragraph in AGENTS.md so that alongside packages/rails-guard, prosecute, gate-manifest, and build-gate, it names plugins/adlc-pi/lib and sibling plugin enforcement cores (plugins/adlc-opencode/lib, plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks, plugins/adlc-codex/hooks, plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks, plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks, plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks, and plugins/adlc-{cursor,gemini,opencode}/rails-checker.mjs). Add a regression test in scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs pinning the AGENTS.md trust-root coverage.
criteria: AGENTS.md names plugins/adlc-pi/lib and sibling plugin enforcement cores in its trust-root tier rule alongside packages/rails-guard, prosecute, gate-manifest, and build-gate.
scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs verifies that AGENTS.md names plugins/adlc-pi/lib and the enforcement packages.
out_of_scope: Modifying runtime code under plugins/ or packages/.
title: docs(agents): name plugins/adlc-pi/lib and plugin enforcement cores as trust-root tier (#938)
